# Knowledge base — bikeshop (fixture)

## Themes

- [product/](product/INDEX.md) — product decisions and idea cards
- [sources/](sources/INDEX.md) — interviews/articles library, one file per material

## Conventions

- Slugs/frontmatter EN. One node = one fact. Evidence = link + quote + locator.
- Fictional data: an invented bike-repair shop; every name and quote is made up.
